mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.name, g.avatar, g.owner_id AS ownerId, g.notice, c.id AS conversationId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_group_member gm WHERE gm.group_id = g.id) AS memberCount, g.created_at AS createdAt FROM im_group g JOIN im_group_member m ON m.group_id = g.id LEFT JOIN im_conversation c ON c.group_id = g.id AND c.conv_type = 'group' WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND g.dissolved_at IS NULL ORDER BY g.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_group (id, name, avatar, owner_id, notice, max_members, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{avatar}, #{ownerId}, #{notice}, #{maxMembers}, NOW())
